name: assistant-for-claude
description: Lets Claude read and search what you talked about in the Assistant bar. Uses your Claude plan, no API key.
long_description: Assistant saves each conversation from the bar as a small text file on this PC (never screenshots). This extension gives the Claude desktop app read-only tools to list, search and open those conversations, so you can say things like "carry on from what I asked Assistant earlier" or "what did Assistant say about that error?". Nothing is uploaded until Claude reads a conversation for the chat you're in.

tools.name: list_assistant_conversations
tools.description: List recent conversations from the Assistant bar

tools.name: search_assistant_conversations
tools.description: Search Assistant conversations for words or phrases

tools.name: read_assistant_conversation
tools.description: Read one Assistant conversation in full (or the latest)

history_folder.title: Assistant history folder
history_folder.description: Where Assistant saves conversations. Leave as is unless you moved it.
